# Capability matrix

<!-- Generated by `npm run references`; edit its sources, not this file. -->

<!-- Source manifest: de550efb1690c991b452629fb048c3f0b8f1c37212e7c6120444acbe6b5cdac0 -->

This generated page is for users checking what cockpit actually enforces in each agent tool. Each cell holds one of four states:

- `enforced`: a dated run of the real tool, beside a deliberately broken control, showed it refusing the forbidden operation.
- `instructed`: cockpit writes the guidance or setting, but nothing makes the agent follow it.
- `generated`: cockpit writes the files, but nobody has checked that the tool even loads them.
- `unavailable`: cockpit writes nothing for this cell.

Only a dated run of the real tool changes a state; writing a file or passing cockpit's own tests never does.

Guard firing is the generated hook refusing a protected operation. Instruction loading is the tool reading the guidance cockpit writes for it, including the guides of sibling repositories. Skills are the tool loading the skills cockpit renders: `cockpit-setup`, `cockpit-explain`, `cockpit-fix` and `cockpit-work`.

| Tool | Guard firing | Instruction loading | Skills |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Code (`claudecode`) | enforced | instructed | instructed |
| Codex (`codexcli`) | enforced (needs a person) | instructed | instructed |
| OpenCode (`opencode`) | enforced | instructed | instructed |
| Cursor (`cursor`) | unavailable | generated | generated |
| Grok Build (`grokcli`) | unavailable | generated | generated |

## Measurements

Each line gives the date and tool version of the run and what it showed.

- Claude Code, guard firing (2026-11-01, version 2.1.316): with the exact push pre-allowed by permissions, the hook refused git push to a protected branch and the remote stayed empty while git status ran; the same checkout without the hook pushed.
- Codex, guard firing (2026-11-01, version 0.165.0): only after a person trusts the hook: untrusted, Codex skipped it and git push ran; trusted (forced with --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust), it refused the push. Trust is per machine and cockpit doctor warns until it is given.
- OpenCode, guard firing (2026-11-01, version 1.19.4): the plugin refused git push and a native read of a secrets file while an unprotected read stayed allowed; before read was routed through the guard, the same read returned the file.
- Claude Code, instruction loading (2026-11-02, version 2.1.316): in a workspace Claude Code had not trusted, CLAUDE.local.md loaded an @-import whose link stayed inside the cockpit checkout but silently skipped one whose link resolved to a sibling beside the checkout, as it skips a missing import; a trusted workspace was not measured.
- Codex, instruction loading (2026-11-02, version 0.165.0): Codex loaded the root AGENTS.md carrying cockpit's line telling the agent to read the sibling guide, but not the guide itself nor a decoy file beside it; reading the guide is left to the agent.
- OpenCode, instruction loading (2026-11-02, version 1.19.4): OpenCode loaded the sibling guide named in the opencode.jsonc instructions list through its link, while a linked guide beside it that the list did not name stayed out.

## Without a measurement

- Guard firing in Cursor and Grok Build: no guard adapter is checked in, so cockpit generates no guard hook.
- Instruction loading in Cursor: cockpit's instructions reach Cursor only through the root AGENTS.md, and .cursor/rules holds only rules overlays; no run of the tool beside a broken control has shown that it loads either.
- Instruction loading in Grok Build: cockpit writes the files, but no run of the tool beside a broken control has shown that it loads them.
- Skills in Claude Code (`.claude/skills`), Codex (`.agents/skills`) and OpenCode (`.opencode/skills`): a person has not yet reviewed whether the tool loads and triggers them as written.
- Skills in Cursor (`.cursor/skills`) and Grok Build (`.grok/skills`): cockpit writes the files, but no run of the tool beside a broken control has shown that it loads them.
